_comment: Versioned release notes. TOP entry feeds the 'What's New' popup on first launch after an update (gated by BUILD_SHA comparison in WhatsNewModal). The full list is rendered as a vertical timeline in the Settings → About → Changelog screen. Add new entries to the top. Each entry needs version (semver) and date (YYYY-MM-DD). Bumps: patch = fix, minor = feature, major = breaking. Keep titles under 60 chars and bullets under 110 chars.

releases.title: PR approval timeline populates (no more 'no workflow configured') + cleaner non-approver view
highlights: Approval timeline + Approvers grid now populate for every Purchase Request — a backend SQL bug was crashing the read endpoint silently and returning an empty list, which the app rendered as 'No approval workflow configured' even on PRs that had real approvers.
Non-approver view no longer shows the redundant 'view only' eye-banner — the Approvers grid above already tells you who's in the loop and whose turn it is.
Backend error logging hardened: queries that crash inside try/catch are now logged to error.log instead of being silently swallowed, so future regressions show up immediately.

releases.title: PR detail mirrors the web admin — 4 tabs, currency, approvers grid, collapsible items
highlights: Purchase Request screen rebuilt to mirror the web admin's Info / Attachments / Comparison / Activity tab layout.
Approvers grid: every configured approver per stage shows their stamp (green check / red X / clock / empty) — no more 'view only' placeholder when you're just spectating.
Total now shows currency (e.g. '600.00 AED'); the screen flags a discrepancy badge if the stored total disagrees with the sum of line items by more than 0.01.
Line items collapsed by default — tap a row to expand long description, spec, and any approved-qty/price overrides.
Notes preserve line breaks and detect URLs (https links are tappable).
Hero now shows the requester's avatar, department, and cost center chips.
Attachments tab lists every file linked to the PR; tap to open in browser.
Comparison tab ranks supplier quotations cheapest-first with a green ribbon on the leader.
Activity tab shows the full purchase log (who did what, when) — same source as the web's Activity Log tab.
Resubmit button appears when you're the requester AND a row is rejected — opens the web admin's edit flow.
Pull-to-refresh on the PR screen — no more back-out-and-re-enter to see new actions.
Backend: check-in 500 fixed (timesheets helper wasn't being loaded by the API path).

releases.title: View As + smooth DnD + canonical PR approve
highlights: View As — Settings → Admin Tools → View As lets admins see the app from any active staff's perspective. Amber banner stays on top so you never forget you're impersonating; tap Stop to revert. Avatar in the top bar reflects the impersonated user too.

PR approve actually works now — the API was hitting the wrong (typo'd) statusdetail table. Fixed to match the web admin's canonical logic. Notes you type appear under the green/red stamp in the timeline.
Notification counts now reflect only items where it's YOUR turn — used to count every PR at a stage you were a configured approver for, even if someone else had already taken it.
Dashboard drag-and-drop is smooth — rewrote the grid so all the math runs on the UI thread. Long-press a tile, drag, drop; neighbours animate into their new slots instead of jumping.
PR detail screen shows the real number (PR-26050023) instead of the internal id (PR-1666).
Broken 'approvals/purch...' bottom-tab icon is gone.
Approve/Cancel buttons in the note modal no longer hide behind the Android nav bar.
Tapping Approve no longer kicks you to the login screen on a 403 — that was a session-expiry false positive.

releases.title: Popover polish + share + fingerprint retry + quiet-hours auto-update
highlights: Tapping a notification now closes the popover (no more lingering window behind the destination)
PR detail screen got a slim inline header — no more huge white container at the top
Approval workflow timeline collapses by default — tap to expand, hidden when you don't need it
Share button on the PR screen → opens Android share sheet (WhatsApp, email, save, etc.)
Login screen now shows a 'Use fingerprint' button when biometric was cancelled — no more retyping password
Pull down on Dashboard to bring the update banner back if you dismissed it
Auto-install during quiet hours: if a new build is out and the app foregrounds 2–5 AM after 15+ min idle, the install fires automatically (no tap)
App icon no longer has the white tile — uses the transparent brand mark

releases.title: Real approvals + native PR screen + customizable dashboard
highlights: Approvals chip in the top bar now pulls REAL pending items (was always 0) — 15+ PR/PO/payment/expense requests where you're the approver
Tap a Purchase Request notification → fully native approval screen with header + line items + workflow timeline + audit history
Dashboard has a new 'My Tasks' tile with sub-line breakdown: X new · Y overdue · Z stale
Dashboard cards are now customizable — tap 'Customize' top-right to reorder + show/hide tiles, persisted per device
Bottom bar: Customers is replaced by Tasks (Customers still in the ERP hub)
Top bar bigger + clickable: tap the PRIZM ENERGY logo / wordmark anywhere to go home

releases.title: Notifications pop out from the bell + tap to open
highlights: Inbox dropdown floats out of the icon you tapped (Approvals · Tasks · Bell · Compliance) with a little arrow pointing at it — no more bottom sheet
Every notification and approval row is now clickable: opens straight into that record's screen
Notifications that don't have a native screen yet (Materials Tracking, etc.) open the web view as a fallback
Removed the welcome card from the dashboard — avatar in the top bar was already doing that job
Arabic text in titles and descriptions now auto-detects and renders right-to-left
Customers tile shows active customers only (153 in production) — was including 18 inactive accounts

releases.title: Real leave balances per UAE + KSA labor law
highlights: My Leave now shows real quotas per type instead of all-null — Annual + Sick + Maternity for all 42 active staff
Annual quota follows UAE Art. 29 + KSA Art. 109 with pro-rata under 1yr
Sick quotas: 90 days UAE / 120 days KSA
Seniority resolved from your oldest contract start date
15 UAE + 2 KSA public holidays seeded for 2026 (was empty)

releases.title: Initial release
highlights: Native Android app for Prizm CRM with JWT auth + biometric unlock
Dashboard with live counts of customers, projects, leads, invoices, tasks
ERP hub listing all 49 modules with native list + detail screens
In-app auto-update from GitHub Releases
